services.name: Ski School
services.desc: Please note: if you are looking for downhill ski lessons, please contact Nordic Valley, Snowbasin, or Powder Mountain. Class registration must be completed online a minimum of 48 hours in advance. There is no same day or on-site registration. Fees for equipment rentals, if needed, or trail passes are in addition to lesson fees. Equipment (skis, boots, & poles) rentals are available for students taking lessons. If you rent equipment from us, you are welcome to use these until 3:00 pm on the day of your class. services.name: Nordic Skiing
services.desc: The 25-26 season has been challenging so far with warm temps and rain delaying Ogden Nordic's opening until Jan 9. We are open but and trails are holding up so far but we need more snow. Several team members as well as Ogden Nordic fans have been working on poetry, writings and other thoughts to boost our spirits. Enjoy and please send us your own writings via the form at the bottom of this page. Yesterday's sky was a perfect blue, the kind of day that feels brand new. I tracked through silence, crisp and bright, just me, the shoes, and the winter light. So let the powder fall thick and fast, to make this winter beauty last. Mud mud mud Frozen mud? Afraid not! services.name: Junior Program
services.desc: We are again offering lessons for children who would like to learn to ski or to improve their nordic skiing technique. Children ages 8-18 of all abilities are welcome, from beginners who have never skied through advanced skiers. The Junior Program aims to get kids out on the snow, develop skills and gain confidence to make skiing winter trails fun and inviting. All classes are open to children age 8-18 except as noted above. Students must be age 8 by 12/31/2025. Lessons are structured such that skiers are paired with others based on age and ability. Advanced skiers may take one or both sessions. blurb: Ogden Nordic offers a Winter Yurt Camping experience in amazing North Fork Park, home to our world-class cross-country ski venue. The Aspen, Elderberry and White Fir Yurts are equipped with one bunk bed, one double bed, table, chairs and a wood stove to cook on and keep you toasty warm following a great day of winter recreation!
